correctness.rationale: Tame Kummer 82-cover has nine finite totally ramified points plus infinity, and Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus 324. Valuations at all branch points and infinity prove the complete basis of 324 regular differentials. The Cartier extraction identity splits it into 81 permutation-indexed blocks; two exact algorithms (polynomial division vs binomial coefficient sums), a line-by-line CSV block certificate, and fourth-iterate nilpotence check reproduce the rank 222 and kernel 102. No extrapolation from finite extension counts is used.

value.rationale: The a-number is a natural geometric Jacobian p-torsion/Ekedahl–Oort invariant of the first even-index curve in a newly introduced family of non-Hermitian-covered maximal curves. Maximality gives zero p-rank but not the precise a-number; the exact value 102 materially distinguishes its supersingular Jacobian from superspecial cases and provides a baseline for computing further Ekedahl–Oort invariants. An exact 81-block calculation with independent certificate is nontrivial and not just a restated genus or automorphism calculation.
